decision.complementary_representation: smoke passes, all primary folds eligible, stationary optimization verified, both primary and optional upper CIs <.05 and neither material gain demonstrated
decision.scorer_bottleneck: smoke passes and (all five primary folds eligible, macro gain >=.05, primary lower CI >0 and >=4 positive folds; OR optional gain>=.05 with paired anchor lower CI>0)

development.artist_sensitivity: same procedure with all normalized credited artists joined transitively
development.group: transitive shared source SHA or video
development.order: sha256(stage5g1a:20260908:group:min-id), assign each group to smallest bucket by track count then bucket index

inputs: exact provenance-validated Arm-D global/front/middle/back independent 512-D vectors

model.family: Arm-D baseline plus ridge-regularized symmetric coordinate-interaction residual
model.feature_scale: sqrt(512), fixed; no fitted scaler or dimensionality reduction
features: mean both directions of global-local products
mean bidirectional best-local-match products, matches chosen by frozen cosine
model.initialization: all zero: exact D0 before fitting
model.loss: anchor-macro softplus(-10 * preference score margin) + 0.5 * ridge * sum(weights squared)
model.optimizer: float64 CPU torch LBFGS, lr=1, max_iter=300, history_size=20, tolerance_grad=1e-9, tolerance_change=1e-12, strong_wolfe
model.score: D0 + dot(weights, fixed interaction features); ranking score, not calibrated probability
model.selection: one fixed model/regularizer; no validation/test hyperparameter selection or early stopping

optional.comparison: historical G1 on previously revealed Stage5G1 TEST preferences, developmental only
optional.execute: after D-view capacity and development results; only if smoke passes
optional.rule: full-song normalized segment cosine matrix; average row maxima and column maxima with equal directional weight

scope: development diagnostic; Stage5G1 TEST already revealed, never fresh confirmation

smoke.selection: hash namespace smoke-anchor then smoke-preference; only anchors with at least four preferences

uncertainty.primary: paired fold-macro bootstrap; five fold estimates with shared training sets, descriptive not population confidence
uncertainty.secondary: stratified within-fold paired-anchor bootstrap with equal fold weighting
